hooks.text: 白天经营道路、资源和民心，夜晚登城操炮守到黎明
hooks.excerpt: By day, gather resources, place buildings, raise walls, and lay roads, keeping your subjects happy with taverns and decorations. By night, man the battlements, unleash ballistas, and hold the line until dawn.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 攻城锤、攻城塔与巨龙压境，需用墙门、投石器和弓手分层防线应对
hooks.excerpt: At sunset, the Moon Beasts strike with battering rams, siege towers and even dragons. Layer your defenses with walls and iron gates, rain fire with catapults and archers, and withstand ever-stronger assaults until sunrise.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 河流夏季是天然护城河，冬季结冰后反成敌军通路
hooks.excerpt: Hills, rivers, and forests can be your castle’s best allies, offering natural moats and tactical positions. But shifting seasons can betray you. A river shields you in summer but freezes solid in winter, creating a bridge for your enemy.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段
